# Taken from Glorp UI by mods/glorpui_hints/tools/fork_hints.py and renamed into
# this mod's own namespace. Do not edit by hand — edit the fork, not the copy.
#
# Source: in_game/common/scripted_triggers/glorpui_societal_value_hint_scripted_triggers.txt
# Their generator's own header follows.
# Societal value hint takeability gates. Evaluated in country scope; PREV inside each object-literal block is that country.

svx_svh_reform_core = {
	government_reform:$KEY$ = {
		is_implementable_in = PREV
		NOT = { is_fully_implemented_in = PREV }
	}
}

# is_fully_implemented_in on a policy is true whenever its law is in force, so the current-policy
# exclusion uses has_policy instead.
svx_svh_policy_core = {
	policy:$KEY$ = {
		is_implementable_in = PREV
	}
	NOT = { has_policy = $KEY$ }
	law:$LAW$ = {
		OR = {
			is_fully_implemented_in = PREV
			is_implementable_in = PREV
		}
	}
}

svx_svh_privilege_takeable = {
	estate_privilege:$KEY$ = {
		is_implementable_in = PREV
		NOT = { is_fully_implemented_in = PREV }
	}
}
